rule: The Gmail message confirms a customer payment received through Krufrefi

rule: The new email is a customer support request received by RISTOK Support

rule: The email is a cloud provider alert about spending, a budget, or a usage limit

rule: The sender is an investor, or the email is clearly about an investment relationship, fundraising, or an investment opportunity

rule: The new email appears to be a newsletter or mailing-list message

rule: The email includes one or more attachments

description: Saves attachments from incoming Gmail messages to Google Drive.

rule: The email is a security alert, a new-device notification, or a password-reset message

title: New Gmail Emails to Slack

title: Weekday Inbox Summary to Slack

title: Log New Emails to Google Sheets

title: Slack DM for New Emails
